title: Llama-modchip: 284B DeepSeek on 64GB RAM, no GPU
why_read: A legitimate technical hack letting a 284-billion-parameter model run on ordinary RAM without a GPU, relevant to anyone interested in local LLM inference optimization.
analysis: This describes running DeepSeek's 284-billion-parameter model on just 64GB of RAM with no GPU, which is a serious feat given the model's size. 'modchip' in the name suggests clever tricks like aggressive quantization, offloading, or memory-mapping schemes to squeeze a model that size into commodity hardware. This matters to engineers because it pushes the boundary of what's practically deployable without expensive GPU clusters, which is useful for self-hosting and edge inference. Worth reading for the specific technique, since the claim is unusual enough to warrant checking how it's actually achieved.
